The perimeter/boundary remains a stable gameplay limit with safe spawn framing and no visible void or unreachable decorative surface.

tasks.instructions: Implement one coordinated release-surface repair. First update the upgrade/weapon choice presenter and its data binding so cards use authored silhouettes and compact stat icons, show only up to three truthful current-to-new deltas (never NEW or LOCKED in CURRENT, no unchanged/exhaustive rows), and expose clear focus/activation states for keyboard, mouse, and gamepad. Next repair the shipped cemetery composition at the existing world/camera/collision seam: expand to a larger traversable scale, retain a coherent external world with external depth beyond the gameplay boundary, keep the central building/landmark grounded and visible, align collision with visible geometry, and verify ordinary movement around every landmark side and the perimeter without pass-through, disappearance, or occlusion. Finally harden the existing dense profile contract so software or unknown renderer runs remain explicitly pending/rejected while native 1920x1080 three-retry evidence can be recaptured truthfully; do not perform speculative performance tuning without a measured hot path. Preserve automatic combat, wave/boss pacing, authoritative run state, preserved authored packages, and release guards. Host recapture and formal issue closure remain validation responsibilities.
